read_json_dataset_streaming: create a JsonDatasetReader to load a JSON file as a streaming dataset with a specified field path
read_json_dataset_map_style: build a JsonDatasetReader to load JSON data files into a regular map-style dataset with custom features
write_dataset_to_json_file: create a JsonDatasetWriter to export a HuggingFace Dataset to a JSON file with gzip compression
write_dataset_to_json_buffer: build a JsonDatasetWriter to write a Dataset to a binary buffer in JSON lines format
write_dataset_json_multiprocess: create a JsonDatasetWriter that uses multiprocessing to export a large Dataset to JSON in parallel
